description: This file defines the SwiftUI view components for the Gateway Onboarding process, including screens for auto-detecting and manually entering gateway connection details, as well as related helper functions and status display components.

classes.name: GatewayOnboardingView
classes.description: Main view for onboarding, rendering connection options and navigation.

classes.name: AutoDetectStep
classes.description: View handling automatic detection and connection to a gateway.

classes.name: ManualEntryStep
classes.description: View for manual entry of gateway connection details, including setup code processing.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusBox
classes.description: Reusable view component to display connection status lines.

methods.name: triggerAutoConnect
methods.description: Attempts to automatically connect to a preferred or last-discovered gateway.

methods.name: autoCandidate
methods.description: Selects a gateway candidate based on stored preferences or fallback logic.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Handles establishing a manual connection based on user-inputted data.

methods.name: manualPortValue
methods.description: Parses the port value from user input.

methods.name: resetManualForm
methods.description: Resets the manual connection form fields.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Processes a setup code to extract connection parameters and apply them.

methods.name: applyURL
methods.description: Parses a URL to fill in connection details in the manual setup form.
